method: Every legacy //IL_ diagnostic resolved to its declaring metadata method token and exact original opcode at the reported offset. Each resulting C# location is drawn from the decompiler's sequence points, including the token-specific appended expansion for folded type initializers. An empty location means that the given IL offset has no visible sequence point, in which case use the enclosing method span and exact IL line.
